label: /doctor:sk-code is a thin router with one default setup target; the command doc routes assets and YAML owns execution behavior.
The setup workflow is read-only, forbids write targets, and reports repair commands for the operator to run.

The eight-leg battery checks provisioning, parent structure, metadata, route guard and sync, drift, derived freshness, and a parsed route decision; it reports verdicts and repair text without applying repairs.
The adaptation guide explains adding/removing surfaces and keep-rules, while /doctor:sk-code setup checks the resulting tree and names repairs.
